name: Aienkien 2 ~Kashiwagisou de Aimashou~
original_name: あいえんきえん２～柏木荘で逢いましょう～
source:
Would you like to see a magic show?
Vampire twins who live for thousands of years crawl into main character's bed and provide mouth service in the moonlight.
There is also a shrine maiden who wants to protect protagonist from the eternal night. What destiny awaits him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
